current_logic.alpha_generation: LightGBM v6 alpha is regime-conditional, with chop-fragility filtering and soft downweighting.
current_logic.signal_combination: Posterior-aware long/short multipliers and EV hurdles convert regime probabilities into executable allowances.
current_logic.risk_management: CRISIS hard kill-switch (leverage=0.0 when hmm_prob_crisis > 0.66); regime policy drives gross scaling and turnover throttling.
current_logic.portfolio_optimization: AWF/TPE maximizes compounding with NSGA-II multi-objective (robust_score + worst_leg penalty + chop_drag), study-wide top-K augmentation, ergodicity penalty, deployability gates.

current_logic.is_oos_calibration: IS-OOS regime distribution drift compensated by (1) S1: BTC benchmark cap @ 35% (2) S3: KL divergence monitoring. Structural mismatch CRISIS ratio=8.07× (IS:2% → OOS:16%) remains unresolved; requires deploy-time threshold calibration.
